seoTitle: How to Manually Charge a Customer in Stripe
metaDescription: Create a manual charge in Stripe using a customer's credit card details directly from your dashboard, without a checkout page.
intro: Not every payment needs a checkout page — sometimes you just need to bill a customer directly from your Stripe dashboard. This guide covers how to create a manual charge using credit card details, along with tips on confirmations and receipts.

steps.heading: Open the manual charge tool
steps.body: In your Stripe dashboard, find the option to create a new payment or charge manually.

steps.heading: Add customer details
steps.body: Enter the customer's information so the charge is properly associated with their account or record.

steps.heading: Enter credit card information
steps.body: Input the card details provided by the customer to process the one-time payment.

steps.heading: Process the payment
steps.body: Submit the charge and confirm it processes successfully before closing out the transaction.

steps.heading: Send confirmation and receipt
steps.body: Provide the customer with a receipt or confirmation once the manual charge has gone through.

faq.question: Is it safe to manually enter a customer's credit card details?
faq.answer: Stripe's dashboard is designed to securely handle card entry, but you should always follow best practices like not storing card numbers outside Stripe.

faq.question: Can I issue a refund on a manually charged payment?
faq.answer: Yes, manual charges can be refunded the same way as any other Stripe payment, either in full or partially.

faq.question: Do I need the customer present to process a manual charge?
faq.answer: No, as long as you have their card details, you can process the charge without the customer needing to be present.

faq.question: Is this method good for recurring billing?
faq.answer: Manual charges work best for one-time payments; for recurring billing, Stripe's subscription tools are a better fit.
